database.onlyOneTarget: Only one target is configured, so there is nothing to switch between.
database.confirmSwitchContent: The server restarts to connect to the new target. This page will reconnect and reload automatically once it is back. Under `npm run dev`, you may need to restart it by hand.
database.reconnectingSubtitle: Waiting for the server to come back up.
backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.description: A full-fidelity snapshot of every table: every field, every relation, driver-agnostic. Not the same as the CSV/Excel export elsewhere in the app, which is a lossy report meant for people to read. This file is scrambled (gzip + obfuscation) so it isn't plain, readable JSON at rest. That's an obfuscation step, not encryption, and does not protect the personal data inside from anyone who actually wants it.
backup.dropzone: Click or drag a JobTrack backup file (.jtbak) here
backup.previewInfo: Backup taken {{date}}. Restoring will replace everything currently in the active database with:
backup.confirmTitle: Replace all data in the active database?
backup.confirmContent: Every table is wiped and recreated from this backup. This cannot be undone.
data.title: Reset & demo data
data.description: Wipe everything in the active database, or (only while it's empty) fill it with a realistic multi-year demo dataset to explore the app with.
data.clearWarning: This permanently deletes every row below. There is no undo. Export a backup first if you might want this data again.

automation.title: Automation
automation.followUp.toggleLabel: Give new applications a follow-up date
automation.followUp.note: Only when you leave the date blank, and never a date that has already passed, so importing old applications does not flood your follow-ups.
automation.ghost.note: Applies to applications still at Applied or Screening where nothing has happened in that long: no status change, and no follow-up date in that time. A follow-up planned for later keeps an application safe. It runs every hour while JobTrack is running. Each change is written to the application's status history with a note saying why, so it is easy to undo.

fitWeights.description: How the 0-100 fit score on the Openings page divides its points, and how strict the summary comparison is. Most people never need to change this; it exists for when the default balance does not match what actually matters to you.
